# The check contexts required at the merge boundary on `main`.
#
# GitHub stores this list in branch protection, where it is invisible from the
# tree and unreviewable in a diff. This file is the copy that can be read, and
# tools/check_ci_gate.py proves every line still names a check that exists and
# can report on a pull request — a required context that never reports leaves
# the PR pending forever.
#
# What is NOT here, on purpose:
#   * the 60-odd individual ci.yml checks — they are matrix-derived names, and
#     `ci-gate` fans in every one of them (rules G1/G2/G3).
#   * deploy-docs, scorecard, release — skipped or absent on pull requests, and
#     GitHub counts a skipped required check as passing (rule G5).
#
# To apply this list (needs admin; PUT replaces the whole protection object, so
# every other setting must be sent with it):
#   gh api -X PUT repos/hawk90/metl/branches/main/protection --input protection.json
# and read it back with:
#   gh api repos/hawk90/metl/branches/main/protection \
#     -q '.required_status_checks.contexts, .enforce_admins.enabled'

ci-gate
analyze / c-cpp
cflite-pr (address)
cflite-pr (undefined)
